sections.heading: Six irregular verbs
sections.body: These don't follow the *yo* rule (their *yo* form doesn't end in *-o*). Learn them as a group — they're very frequent. A trick: they spell **DISHES** — *Dar, Ir, Saber, Haber, Estar, Ser*.

sections.heading: Stem-changing verbs
sections.body:
- *-ar* and *-er* verbs change exactly as in the present — everywhere except *nosotros*: *querer → quiera, quieras, quiera, queramos, quieran*; *poder → pueda, puedas, pueda, podamos, puedan*.
- *-ir* stem-changers change in **all** forms, and *nosotros* gets the small change (e → i, o → u): *pedir → pida, pidas, pida, **pidamos**, pidan*; *dormir → duerma, duermas, duerma, **durmamos**, duerman*; *sentir → sienta, … **sintamos**…*

sections.heading: Hay que and haya
sections.body: *Haya* is the subjunctive of *hay*: *Espero que haya comida.* (I hope there's food.) It's also used to form the present perfect subjunctive, which you'll learn later in B1: *Espero que hayas llegado bien.*

examples: Quiero que vayas conmigo.
I want you to go with me.
Necesito que estés aquí a las ocho.
I need you to be here at eight.
Quiero que seas feliz.
I want you to be happy.
Espero que haya comida.
I hope there's food.
Quiero que sepas la verdad.
I want you to know the truth.
Necesito que me des tu número.
I need you to give me your number.
Quiero que puedas venir.
I want you to be able to come.
No quiero que pidas pizza otra vez.
I don't want you to order pizza again.
Quiero que duermas bien.
I want you to sleep well.
El médico quiere que durmamos ocho horas.
The doctor wants us to sleep eight hours.
Necesito que seamos puntuales.
I need us to be on time.
Quiero que vayamos al cine.
I want us to go to the movies.
No quieren que estemos tristes.
They don't want us to be sad.
Espero que no haya problemas.
I hope there are no problems.
Quiero que me den permiso.
I want them to give me permission.
Mi jefe quiere que sea más puntual.
My boss wants me to be more punctual.
Necesito que quieras ayudar.
I need you to want to help.
Quiero que sientas lo mismo.
I want you to feel the same.
